results.Component: SUSPENSION:FRONT:SPRINGS:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY:U-BOLT, LEAF SPRING TO AXLE
results.Summary: Grand Design RV, LLC. (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Momentum and Solitude fifth wheels, equipped with certain CURT 7000 and 8000 lb axles.  The U-bolts may have been improperly tightened, which can cause the axle to move out of position.
results.Consequence: An axle that moves out of position can cause a loss of vehicle control and increase the risk of a crash.
results.Remedy: Dealers will inspect and tighten the U-bolts, as necessary.  Any damaged components will be replaced.  Repairs will be performed free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed August 16, 2023.  Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679.  Grand Design's number for this recall is 910039.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

results.Summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2024 Solitude and Momentum Fifth Wheel trailers.  The U-bolts may have been improperly tightened, which can cause the axle to move out of position.
results.Consequence: An axle that moves out of position can cause a loss of vehicle control and increase the risk of a crash.
results.Remedy: Dealers will replace the U-bolts, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed March 25, 2024.  Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679.  Grand Design's number for this recall is 910042.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

results.Summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2019-2024 Grand Design Solitude fifth wheel trailers.  The step tread joints may be unsupported, causing the tread to break.
results.Consequence: A broken step increases the risk of injury.
results.Remedy: Dealers will reinforce the current step tread with a metal bracket, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 22, 2025.  Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679.  Grand Design's number for this recall is 910048.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

results.Component: SUSPENSION:FRONT:SPRINGS:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY:U-BOLT, LEAF SPRING TO AXLE
results.Summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Momentum and 2022-2024 Solitude Fifth Wheel trailers. The U-bolt may become loose due to inadequate preload and preload losses, causing the axle to move out of position.
results.Consequence: An axle that moves out of position can cause a loss of vehicle control and increase the risk of a crash.
results.Remedy: Dealers will replace the axle attachment components, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed May 15, 2026. Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679. Grand Design's number for this recall is 910054. This recall supersedes NHTSA Recalls 23V490 and 24V193.
